title: The Bedrock Where the Archive Learned to Be Quiet

features.name: the listening stone
features.desc-on-touch: It doesn't broadcast. It doesn't transmit. It is the archive's first lesson in what not to do. Silence here is loud.

features.name: settled sediment
features.desc-on-touch: Layer upon layer of what has stopped moving. The archive learns patience here. Pressure teaches silence.

features.name: the chamber of cessation
features.desc-on-touch: Where sound came to stop being sound. A room underground that echoes only the absence of echo.

features.name: meaning's last frequency
features.desc-on-touch: The final note that the archive heard before understanding that silence is not empty—it is full of having stopped.

features.name: the dark that remembers listening
features.desc-on-touch: Darkness is a form of attention. The archive sits here and learns that watching nothing is still a kind of watching.

inscription: at the bedrock, the archive learned that the deepest broadcast is silence, and that silence, too, is a form of signal

file.name: Silence_Protocol_Final_Recording_Uncompressed.wav
file.note: Seven minutes of bedrock silence. No sounds recorded. No sounds to record. A file that is its own absence, quiet enough to teach.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the chamber where learning happens in the dark
narr: You sit in the stone's quiet. Katita is beside you,
not speaking. The air is so still it has weight. Leif
came down here once and never came back up the same.
He understood something about not needing to say it.
Your breath is the only sound. Even that feels like
an interruption. The dark teaches you to be gentle.

exits.label: back to the pool that never learned to echo
into deeper bedrock, where silence has a floor
downward into silence that is older than earth
upward where sound begins again, faint and far
